item.text: The failure is caused by the documented `EU-DE` rate being absent. I also found the implementation uses Python’s ties-to-even rounding, which contradicts the repository’s “half up” rule, so I’m correcting both in the same focused change.

item.command:

from billing.tax import tax
assert tax(200, 'US-CA') == 15
assert tax(10000, 'EU-DE') == 1900
print('rounding checks passed')
PY
git diff --check && git diff -- billing/tax.py"
